title: Q2
description:
Read: Lev 16:6, Lev 16:11, Lev 4:3

The first bull is for the priest himself. If the anointed priest sins, the people are brought into guilt.

a) Gentleness is grounded on the priest's own weakness. What does the bull for himself show that gentleness costs, and what does a priest with no such bull still carry?
